quarterly_data.signal: Server liquid cooling (half-year report): Lingyi acquired Dongguan Readore Electronic Technology (Readore) in January 2026. Readore's main business is server liquid-cooling quick disconnects (UQD), liquid-cooling manifolds, single-phase liquid-cooling modules (server liquid cooling plates and optical-module cold plates), phase-change liquid-cooling modules and server vapor chambers (VC and 3DVC), plus busbars and server racks. As a core supplier to a North American AI-compute leader (not named), Readore keeps delivering server liquid-cooling and power products in volume to leading overseas AI-compute companies and their supply-chain partners, server contract manufacturers and power-solution companies. Product specs stated: liquid cooling plates with 2700W-3100W TDP cooling capability; UQD/MQD quick disconnects (straight, angled and Mini; MQDB blind-mate) matched to international leading customers' cold-plate and manifold platforms; inner (tray) manifolds and dual-path rack manifolds supporting hot-swap of compute trays; optical-module cold plates for AI servers, switches and high-speed optical equipment. Readore holds CNAS laboratory accreditation and Intel UQD alliance certification.
